summary: The task failed despite creating a workbook with correct formulas. The trace reveals critical gaps in the existing excel-financial-reconciliation skill: (1) Wrong row references - the agent used row 9 for Ending Balance when it should be row 13-14 per the Harbor format, and row 11/13 for GL Balance when it should be row 16; (2) The skill's column mapping section is ambiguous about whether April is column N or O, causing the agent to flip-flop; (3) Missing explicit row mapping table that ties summary sheet rows to detail sheet control rows; (4) The verification section doesn't catch the case where formulas reference wrong rows entirely. The skill needs clearer row-to-row mapping guidance and a verification script that validates the actual row structure against expected Harbor format.
